title: Bardo National Museum (Tunis)

terrainReference.basis: Original source elevation just outside the east historic frontage.

mapIdentity.scope: The 18-point native outer rim maps the complete standing building. Heritage descriptions establish historic palace and modern wing. The junction and internal openings are interpreted.

note: Three mapped stories and the exact garden overview establish pale wall planes and projecting blue timber bays. The heritage institute verifies the portico. The written design description and mapped modern wing support the monumental entrance and skylight massing.
